note: Features of the QA Factory package for Forge metrics. A file under ai-packages/qa-factory/ belongs to the first feature whose globs match it (root=package, globs relative to that folder); a file elsewhere in the repo is matched against the root=repo features (globs relative to the repo root). A backlog row or a journal event is attributed by an explicit tag (F07), else by the files it names, else by its stage words. A file matching no feature is UNCLASSIFIED and tools/forge_metrics.py prints it: register the feature here (a new feature = a new row, next free id). Order matters (first match wins): specific before general; no file may match two features with the SAME specificity (specificity = the number of literal characters of the matching glob; tools/test_forge_metrics.py enforces it). Glob syntax: * = any run without '/', ** = any run including '/', ? = one character. Seed: plans/feature-fragility-2026-10-02.md (hand attribution of 02.10, Table C is the oracle for the file column).
